children: Japan's Nikkei Stock Average is flat at 60451.02 as gains in bank and pharmaceutical shares offset losses in technology and machinery stocks. Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group rises 1.9% and Takeda Pharmaceutical is 2.0% higher, while SoftBank Group is down 9.5% and JX Advanced Metals is 3.2% lower. Broader market index Topix gains 0.7% to 3919.72. The dollar is at 158.67 yen, compared with Y158.04 as of Tuesday's Tokyo stock market close. Investors are closely watching domestic earnings as well as crude oil prices. Nissan Motor is set to announce its quarterly results later Wednesday. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
